audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Blow was referred to only as 'his E-knockback' with no name, no cooldown and no statement of what it costs you. The stance swap's armour-and-MR shred on the first Mercury Cannon attack was absent entirely, and the full layer wrote 'Beartrap' instead of Bear Trap on a Rope.
audit.why: Riot's E text, Hammer Stance: deals magic damage and knocks the target back — 20/18/16/14/12/10s. Riot's R text: the first attack after swapping to Mercury Cannon reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist, and the swap itself is a 6s auto-attack reset. Kled's W is four attacks; a knockback mid-sequence throws away the rest of them and the fourth-hit bonus.
audit.corrected: Thundering Blow named with its 20s rank-1 cooldown and the knockback's real cost written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], phases[1].why and dontsFull[2].d; the swap reset written into dontsFull[1].d and the Cannon shred into wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Jayce while whys[0] calls it 'a quiet last-hitting standoff', Level 6 read Jayce while whys[4] says your R evens the lane, and 2+ items read Jayce while whys[6] says you run a squishy Jayce down.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Jayce / Jayce / Skill / Skill / Skill / Kled, and the mirror states it set Level 1 and Level 6 to Skill and 2+ items to Kled.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Skill / Skill / Kled with ratings moved, and the three generic phases whys rewritten to state the real reason for each.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Shock Blast, dodge it' carried no number, and the reason his poke phase is so punishing — the Acceleration Gate empowering the same ability — was never connected to it in the full layer.
audit.why: Riot's E text, Cannon Stance: if Shock Blast is fired through the gate, the missile's speed, range and damage all increase. Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1, so a dodged one is a real step-up window.
audit.corrected: The 16s number and the gate empowerment written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5].

edits.before: Mounted stats bully every level-1 exchange. Identify how Jayce contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you has a real level 1 — you want to bank Skaarl's mount health, he wants range. A last-hitting standoff.

edits.before: Q beartrap is the kill switch — land it and rip the combo. Only take the trade when Jayce's Shock Blast is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is the kill switch — but Thundering Blow (20s) knocks you out of the follow-up. Bait it.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jayce's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! (140s) is the engage he has no answer to — land it from fog and the poke lane evens out at 6.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Jayce carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He has no scaling and no escape — your stacked W procs, the remount health bar and bruiser items run down a squishy Jayce.

edits.before: Beartrap Jayce when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope Jayce once Thundering Blow is spent, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, and far worse fired through his Acceleration Gate. Dodge it. - Thundering Blow: a 20s knockback that ends your all-in. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, worse through his gate — dodge it, then step up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His stance swap resets his auto — the wind-up is your cue to back.

edits.before: Giving away the dismount for free — mounted HP is a resource; spending it on poke instead of all-ins loses the lane.
edits.after: Thundering Blow ends the all-in — knocked back, you lose the rest of your W shots and eat poke walking in a second time.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Shock Blast (16s) hits harder through the gate; Thundering Blow (20s) knocks you off him.

edits.before: Poke you below remount threshold and dismount Skaarl before you ever reach hammer range
edits.after: Swap to Mercury Cannon and open with the armour-shredding first hit, then poke Skaarl down

notes: The direction of Bear Trap on a Rope is stated correctly on this page — 'Q-pull him in' matches Riot's text that the shackled target is yanked toward Kled — so I left every instance alone; the mirror auditor found the reversed claim on Jayce's own page, not here. Worth flagging for a champion-level pass: Shock Blast and To the Skies! share one Q cooldown that scales 16/14/12/10/8/6 across six ranks because of the stance system, so 'Shock Blast's cooldown' phrasing on this page is really 'his Q cooldown in either stance'. Kled's Q knockup versus Jayce is only relevant as displacement, and nothing in either kit makes it unstoppable-proof, so I asserted nothing there.
